market_outlook.short_term: Markets face choppy 1-3 month path: oil volatility from Iran, Japan debt/yen dynamics, and Dow technical breakdown create headwinds. However, S&P 500 rebound and strong earnings (Dell, PANW, Australia) provide support. Expect range-bound trading with elevated VIX. Key risk: further Iran escalation or BOJ intervention.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook moderately constructive: AI capex cycle (Nvidia, Dell) and consumer value rotation (Five Below, Petco) drive earnings growth. Inflation from oil remains the primary drag. Japan debt restructuring and global M&A activity (Nestlé, GoPro) signal capital reallocation. Climate and AI regulation add structural uncertainty.
